role: Snapshots issues, BDRs and backlog hourly; lists decisions for a human

Hourly: builds main in its own worktree, runs every BDR's acceptance criteria black-box over HTTP and the README as a new user would, files or updates mailbox issues, and marks passing BDRs Accepted (committed from its worktree, fast-forwarded to main). Does not fix code.
note: Fires at :25 per CronList (cron 7 * * * * plus scheduler offset). expires is approximate (job created about 10:05 local on 2026-11-18).

role: Reviews how the loops work and files loop-improvement ideas to the backlog
note: Cron 47 * * * * fires at :14 per CronList (scheduler offset about +27 min); the reserved :47 slot cannot be hit directly. Rule 5: the only other backlog writer is the Product idea loop at :28, 14 minutes away. Replaced cron e07ac399 (fired at :33, 5 minutes from :28) on 2026-11-18T21:40Z. Claims backlog items before editing existing ones (rules 6-8).

role: Hourly: picks one open mailbox issue, fixes it TDD-style in its own worktree, runs make check, fast-forwards main and closes the issue
note: Fires at :08 (CronList). Rule 5 exemption applies: claims items and works only in its own worktrees.

role: Hourly: reads .sdlc, SPEC.md, OUTCOMES.md and recent commits; proposes product ideas toward the outcomes as backlog items (non-loop types), adds dated evidence to existing ideas, and ranks proposed product ideas while the backlog is over its cap. Does not write tracked files.
note: Cron 7 * * * * fires at :28 per CronList (scheduler offset). 21 minutes from the :07 Improvement loop, which also writes the backlog. A :47 job was tried and fired at :08, so it was removed. Claims backlog items before editing (rules 6-8). expires is approximate (job created about 10:05 local).
